title: A Silly Wish
lines: Meg has a pup. His name is Gus.
Gus sits and looks at the fish tank.
He wants to swim just like a fish.
That is a silly wish for a pup.
Gus jumped up at the tank and slid.
Meg held the tank so it did not tip.
"You can not swim in there," she said.
Meg felt sad. Then she had a plan.
She got a big tub from the shed.
Mom and Meg fill it in the sun.
Gus jumped in with a big splash.
The cold made his black nose go pinkish.
Soon the water was brownish with mud.
Gus moves his legs and swims a bit.
Now Gus is as happy as a fish.

questions.listenFor: To swim like a fish. Lines two and three say it.

questions.ask: What did Meg get from the shed, and why?
questions.listenFor: A big tub, so Gus had water of his own. The fish tank was not safe.

questions.ask: What else could Meg have done for Gus? Why?
questions.listenFor: Any kind answer counts. The story says brownish and pinkish, not brown and pink - sort of that color. Let them try an -ish word of their own.
